title: Submitting a Root Edit proposal requires holding 1% of circulating AGENT7 supply and posting publicly on the Sky Forum
content:
A.6.1.1.8.2.2.2.2.1.2.1.1 opens the routine amendment path: "The Root Edit process begins with an AGENT7 token holder submitting a proposal through the Powerhouse system containing a draft Artifact Edit Proposal. An AGENT7 token holder must hold at least 1% of the circulating token supply to submit a proposal. The proposal must also be posted on the Sky Forum under the 'Launch Agent 7 Prime' category."

The two conditions do different work. The 1% threshold is a cost filter — it makes proposal rights scale with skin in the game and bounds the number of proposals the Operational Facilitator must review inside their seven-day clock. The Forum requirement is a transparency rule: the *initiating* document is public before any review happens, so the Facilitator's later finding can be checked against what was actually proposed.

Note what the threshold is measured against: **circulating** supply, not Genesis Supply. Since distribution from the 1 billion Genesis Supply is still undefined, the effective difficulty of the gate is not yet determinable from the Artifact — early on, when little is circulating, 1% may be trivially reachable.

The design also concentrates initiative: a holder below 1% has no route to propose an Artifact change at all, only to vote on changes others propose.
description: Two gates combine: a token-weighted stake filter against spam, and mandatory publication under a named Forum category so no proposal can travel privately to the reviewer.
